source.author: verg
source.text: Ac velut ingentem formicae farris acervum cum populant, hiemis memores, tectoque reponunt; it nigrum campis agmen, praedamque per herbas convectant calle angusto; pars grandia trudunt obnixae frumenta umeris; pars agmina cogunt castigantque moras; opere omnis semita fervet.
source.text_original: Ac velut ingentem formicae farris acervum / cum populant, hiemis memores, tectoque reponunt; / it nigrum campis agmen, praedamque per herbas / convectant calle angusto; pars grandia trudunt / obnixae frumenta umeris; pars agmina cogunt / castigantque moras; opere omnis semita fervet.
source.text_english: And just as ants, when they plunder a great heap of grain, mindful of winter, and store it away beneath cover; so the black column moves across the fields, and they haul the spoil over the grass along a narrow track; some, straining, push along the large grains on their shoulders; some gather the ranks and chide the laggards; every path is alive with labor.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: fervere cuncta virum coetu, simul undique cernit delatum nemus et docta resonare bipenni litora; iam pinus gracili dissolvere lamna Thespiaden iungique latus lentoque sequaces molliri videt igne trabes, remisque paratis Pallada velifero quaerentem bracchia malo.
reuse.text_original: fervere cuncta virum coetu, simul undique cernit / delatum nemus et docta resonare bipenni / litora; iam pinus gracili dissolvere lamna / Thespiaden iungique latus lentoque sequaces / molliri videt igne trabes, remisque paratis / Pallada velifero quaerentem bracchia malo.
reuse.text_english: he sees all things seething with a company of men, and at the same time the grove brought in from every side and the shores echoing with the skilled double axe; already the pine is being split into thin planks, the Thespian joined, and the sides fitted together, and the following timbers softened by the slow fire, and Pallas, with the oars prepared, seeking the arms on the sail-bearing mast.
